ayahs.text: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.translation: By the Mount

ayahs.text: وَكِتَٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
ayahs.translation: And a Scripture inscribed

ayahs.text: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
ayahs.translation: On fine parchment unrolled

ayahs.text: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.translation: And the House frequented

ayahs.text: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.translation: And the roof exalted

ayahs.text: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.translation: And the sea kept filled

ayahs.text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
ayahs.translation: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass

ayahs.text: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
ayahs.translation: There is none that can ward it off

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
ayahs.translation: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving

ayahs.text: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement

ayahs.text: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then woe that day unto the deniers

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Who play in talk of grave matters

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.translation: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

ayahs.text: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny

ayahs.text: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Is this magic, or do ye not see

ayahs.text: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight

ayahs.text: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire

ayahs.text: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do

ayahs.text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

ayahs.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
ayahs.translation: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned

ayahs.text: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.translation: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire

ayahs.text: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin

ayahs.text: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
ayahs.translation: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls

ayahs.text: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious

ayahs.text: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.translation: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful

ayahs.text: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.translation: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
ayahs.translation: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time

ayahs.text: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.translation: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.translation: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe

ayahs.text: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful

ayahs.text: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators

ayahs.text: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing

ayahs.text: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons

ayahs.text: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt

ayahs.text: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down

ayahs.text: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared

ayahs.text: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
ayahs.translation: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds

ayahs.text: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not

ayahs.text: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.translation: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest

ayahs.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.translation: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars
